_README: App-owned Remote Config DEFAULTS (the only bundled ads config; it lives in the app, never in the wrapper). Each ad key maps an AppAdKeys placement to an AdMob unit id; EMPTY = that slot never calls AdMob and gracefully no-ops (no request, no render, no crash). Every ad unit id here — including the four mandatory base keys — is intentionally EMPTY: real unit ids are supplied later only through the project's own Firebase Remote Config. The AdMob APPLICATION id (not a unit id) lives in base-application-wrapper/res/values/ads_id.xml. Non-ad keys (privacy_policy, term_of_use) carry real URLs.
